branchName.instructions: Short lowercase names describing the change, e.g. settings-long-command or fix-math-blocks. No prefixes.

commitMessage.instructions: Start with the area touched (Settings, Answers, README, CI…), a colon, then one plain-English sentence on what changes for the user. No Conventional Commits.

pullRequest.instructions: One short paragraph on what changes for the user, then a Test plan section listing what was checked (pytest, ruff, manual run with screenshots if the UI changed).
